scope.scope: Audit existing U rows; replace incomplete U days only with qualifying NOAA fallback, otherwise omit as unknown when explicitly requested. Existing N fills and C crests preserved.
scope.completeDayRequirement: Every expected six-minute instant, both day edges, no internal gaps or conflicting/unknown-quality observations
scope.trustedObservationPolicy: Finite A or P observations, including A/P+e estimated values; unknown flags, ungraded values and conflicting instants excluded from lower bounds.
scope.proxyPolicy: A rounded NOAA proxy must not fall below any trusted finite local USGS observation; no hybrid/max estimate is invented.
scope.aggregatePolicy: Counts rebuilt from canonical hundredth-foot runtime rows; unchanged event authority metadata retained; Gumbel refitted only when water-year maxima change. Original full-precision fit inputs are unavailable.

beforePublishedReturnIntervals.method: Gumbel method-of-moments fit to water-year maxima from the canonical USGS-first, bias-corrected NOAA, USGS-crest-override composite

afterCanonicalReturnIntervals.method: Gumbel method-of-moments fit to water-year maxima from the canonical USGS-first, bias-corrected NOAA, USGS-crest-override composite
afterCanonicalReturnIntervals.inputPrecision: Canonical dailyPeakCompact values, hundredths of a NAVD88 foot
afterCanonicalReturnIntervals.coverageCaveat: Includes partial water years as in the original fit; not a revalidated engineering frequency model.

historicalStormCrossCheck.note: Stone Harbor municipal presentation independently lists this station peak as 6.22 ft; North Wildwood city-gauge peaks are a different location.

caveats: Current USGS provisional values and approved revisions may differ from original retrievals; no particular upstream cause is asserted.
Only original U rows are audited. Existing NOAA-filled days and pre-2007 history are not certified by this audit.
Nonqualifying USGS days use a full verified hourly NOAA proxy plus the existing bias only if it does not contradict a trusted local observation; all other days are explicitly unknown, never invented.
Daily Tidal High-High statistic 00021 is not substituted for a calendar-day maximum. Maximum statistic 00001 is unavailable at this station.
Return-interval fit is only recomputed using its existing water-year Gumbel method, not independently scientifically validated.
fullEvidence: Full per-day audit, original archive backup and raw checksum snapshots retained separately from the runtime application.
